title: feat(console): the list's Options as a menu, and a view dropdown that creates views in place
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRuogP8Tp8XyFXLc92Bxvo6)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Fixes #35551
Fixes #35553

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：列表的「选项」变成分级菜单（视图名、字段、分组、行高、更多，以及「保存」「恢复默认」）；视图下拉按「我的视图 / 共享视图」分组，每行带类型图标，底部「添加视图」原地变成小卡片，几步就能新建视图。
- 为什么做：属于列表页重做这一大项，解决改列、建视图要绕很多步、还会看到开发者用语和机器名的问题。
- 出错会怎样：只影响列表上的个人显示偏好和新建视图入口；共享视图的草稿与发布规则、权限都没改，合并后如有问题可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes

**Options (#35551).** The view bar's 「选项」 opens a menu: each row names a setting on the left and its value on the right, and opens a second level.
- The levels: the view's name, Layout, Fields (「已显示 N 个」), Grouping, Row color, Row height (紧凑 / 标准 / 宽松) and More (how records open, row numbers, inline edit). On a phone a Sort row is added.
- **Fields.** The level is the list's shared field list (`conditions/FieldList.tsx`, the one 筛选 and 排序 open), used as the view's field manager. Search is on top. The shown fields are listed in the grid's column order, each led by its type icon. Each can be dragged (or moved with the arrow keys on its handle) and hidden by its eye. The hidden fields sit below (尚未加入视图), and one click brings one back. Only fields the reader may read are offered.
  - The order is written through `onColumnStateChange`, the state a header drag writes, and the widths are kept beside it. A drag moves a field among the shown ones. Hidden fields keep their place relative to the others, not their slot.
- **Row height on a gallery** picks the card size by name (`setMode`). It no longer cycles.
- **The view name** heads the menu.
  - The owner of one of their own views renames it in place there. So does an admin on a saved shared view, through the same door Manage views uses.
  - Opening the menu does not put the cursor in that field.
- **Footer.**
  - 「恢复默认」 is the personalization marker's reset. It is dimmed while there is nothing to restore.
  - On one of the reader's own views that differs from what it stores, 「保存」 sits beside it. 「保存」 writes the list on screen into that view: it is the marker's 保存 (#30073), offered only to a reader with update on their views. `ListPersonalizedMarker.tsx` is unchanged.
- **Copy.** No icon-only control is left without a name, and the developer note under Open records is gone.
- **Storage.** The settings stay the reader's own preference, stored as before.

**View dropdown and in-place create (#35553).** The title switcher mounts the new dropdown body.
- **The list.** Search stays. There is one row per view, led by its type icon. The reader's own views (我的视图) and the shared views are grouped. A long name wraps instead of being cut. 「管理视图」 is unchanged.
- **The create card.** 「添加视图」 at the foot turns the dropdown into a card:
  - a name, beside the chosen type's icon;
  - the view type, with icons;
  - the one field the type needs (kanban: its group field; calendar: its date field). It defaults to a field the list shows, so a kanban groups by 阶段 rather than a hidden 审批状态;
  - 「包含当前的筛选和排序」 while the list holds unsaved conditions, on by default;
  - a personal / shared switch, only for a reader who may create shared views.
- **What 「创建」 makes.**
  - By default it makes one of the reader's own views and opens it.
  - A shared view goes through the existing draft-and-publish door, unchanged.
  - No machine name is asked for: a unique key is generated from the name.
- **Save as my view** and its name-dialog mode are folded into this card. The rename mode stays. The full Create View dialog is still reachable from Manage views.

**Host wiring.**
- `ObjectView.tsx`: three cleared edits — the create options into `useObjectViewTitleSwitcher`, the save-as mode removed, and `listViewActions: { rename, save, reset }` into `useObjectViewListRenderer`.
- `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`: forwards those to `ListView` as `onRenameView`, `onSaveView` and `onResetView`.
- `ListView.tsx`: changes only at the Options mount and the new prop intake, plus the two dead defaults-table rows.

**Packs.** `list.optionsMenu.fieldsShown` is a count family in every pack. Four keys no surface reads any more are dropped from every pack: `list.recordOpenNote`, `list.recordOpenDeclaredPage`, `view.switcher.all` and `view.switcher.saveAsMyView`. zh-Hant is regenerated.

**Not here.** The menu's own field list is gone. Its Fields level imports ux-1's shared `FieldList`, with the props merged in PR #35634 (the list itself landed in PR #35622), and `FieldList.tsx` is not edited here. The menu's eight field-list words (`list.optionsMenu.searchFields` and its siblings) were added by this PR and never shipped, so they leave the packs with the local copy; the shared list brings its own words. This PR changes no `packages/spec`, no server code and no endpoint.

## Tests

**New:**
- `ViewSettingsPopover.optionsMenu-35551.test.tsx` (the menu, its levels, Fields, words, 保存 / 恢复默认, the focus on open)
- `ListView.optionsHost-35551.test.tsx` (column order through `onColumnStateChange`, each Fields row's declared type, the gallery's Row height)
- `inPlaceViewCreate-35553.test.tsx` (key generation, `buildInPlaceViewConfig`, `useCreateViewInPlace`, the card including its default pick, the dropdown body)

**Migrated** (to the menu's levels and the card):
- plugin-list:
  - `ListView.displayPopover-12423`, `ListView.displayResetBaseline-12949`, `ListView.fieldListRead-11984`, `ListView.harness`, `ListView.onGroupingChange-11860`, `ListView.permissions`;
  - `ListView.personalization-28950` (the reset is now dimmed rather than absent under a host, plus the host's 保存, 恢复默认 and rename);
  - `ListView.phoneSortSearch-28911`, `ListView.phoneWidth-29074`, `ListView.restoreViewDefaults-28948`, `ListView.toolbarIconButtons-12695`;
  - `ViewSettingsPopover.recordOpen-26681`, `.rowColorTitle`, `.sharedSelect-11865`.
- app-shell:
  - `objectViewTitleSwitcher.test` (+ the create-card case);
  - `ObjectView.personalViews-29635` (Save as my view through the card, plus Options 保存 / 恢复默认 / rename);
  - `ObjectView.createChartView-11576`, `ObjectView.createKanbanView-11581`, `ObjectView.createViewRefusal-11578` (the Create View dialog is reached through Manage views);
  - `ObjectView.chartRelay-7823`, `ObjectView.emptyColumnsNoProjection-10694`, `ObjectView.listUrlState-11860`, `ObjectView.recordOpenDisplay-26681`.

**Moved to the shared field list** (round 3): `optionsMenu-35551`, `optionsHost-35551`, `ListView.fieldListRead-11984` and `ObjectView.emptyColumnsNoProjection-10694` read the Fields level through `FieldList`'s test ids (`options-fields-hide-`, `-item-`, `-move-`, `-row-`). The drag case now expects a hidden field to keep its relative place, the shared list's rule.

**Retired:**
- `ViewSettingsPopover.layoutFold.test.tsx`. The Layout fold is gone; its pin moved to the Layout level in `optionsMenu-35551`.
- The `reorderShownFields` helper case in `optionsMenu-35551`: the helper went with the local field list.

## Acceptance notes

docs/qa/platform-checklist items edited:
- **`records-forms.saved-view-management`** (rev 3 → 4):
  - New: the `create-in-place` variant, a step and an acceptance clause.
  - steps[0]: the Create View dialog opens from Manage views.
  - steps[7] and the non-admin clause name the shared-view create as the absent affordance. 「添加视图」 stays for a reader who may save views of their own.
- **`records-forms.grid-personalization`** (rev 7 → 8): steps[1] and acceptance[1] are re-pointed to the Row height level (grid and gallery). Stored values are unchanged.

Browser readings: the CRM example, 1280×800, zh-CN, on `crm_opportunity`. A is the admin. B is a member bound to `crm_sales_rep` only, who holds no shared-view rights.

<details><summary>#35551 验收</summary>

- Hiding 「赢单概率」: **3 clicks** (选项 → 字段 → its eye). The column left the header at once. Adding it back: **3 clicks** (选项 → 字段 → it under 尚未加入视图). Re-measured on the shared field list at daa098ff16: 3 and 3. Every row carried its declared type (金额 currency, 客户 lookup, 赢单概率 percent, 预计成交日期 date, and so on).
- Searching 「概率」 narrowed the Fields level to that one field.
- Dragging 金额 onto 商机名称 changed the header order at once. A reload kept it.
- No nameless control on the menu or on any level reachable at this width (字段, 分组, 行高, 更多; Sort is the phone-only row). Neither 「对象声明」 nor the old 「个人偏好，不进…」 note appears.
- A hid 「赢单概率」 on 全部商机. B opened the same view and still saw 「赢单概率」.
- On B's own view with an unsaved filter, Options showed 保存 · 恢复默认 · 刷新. **2 clicks** (选项 → 保存) wrote it: the 「已个性化」 marker went, and a reload showed the saved list. 恢复默认 then read dimmed.
- Renaming the view from Options' name field changed the switcher title.

</details>

<details><summary>#35553 验收</summary>

- A kanban grouped by 阶段, as B: **5 clicks + one name typed** (view name → 添加视图 → type → 看板 → 创建). The group field defaulted to 阶段. The new view opened. No snake_case or machine key appeared anywhere in the dropdown, the card or the title.
- B (no shared-view rights, so the card had no shared switch) created it. It is listed under 我的视图. A's dropdown does not list it.
- With an unsaved filter 阶段 = 赢单 (筛选 1, 7 records), the new view opened reading 筛选 1 and 7 records, every card 赢单, and it was not personalized: the filter is the view's own.
- Every dropdown row is led by its type icon. The trigger reads the view name with its record count (e.g. 「阶段看板乙 7」).
- Two views named 「华东区重点客户季度跟进商机甲组」 and 「…乙组」, identical in their first 13 characters, are both shown in full. They wrap, and none is clipped.

</details>

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` — the `listViewActions` gating: rename for the owner or an admin on a saved view; 保存 / 恢复默认 only while personalized.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` — `FieldsPage` (the shared `FieldList` fed from the grid's columns) and the footer.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/CreateViewDialog.tsx` — `CreateViewCard` and the `shownFields` default.

Two-minute check: on the CRM example open 商机, click 「选项」 → 「字段」 → the eye beside 「赢单概率 (%)」. The column disappears in three clicks.

**Size.** 4555 changed lines in 51 files (+3437 −1118, `git diff --shortstat origin/main...HEAD` at daa098ff16), over the 3000-line human-merge line: landing needs a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval after L1. Of those, 2486 are product code, 306 are the eleven packs, 50 are the changeset and the checklist, and 1713 are tests (951 new, 542 migrated, 220 retired). The PR stays a draft.

## Review order

Changed lines (added + removed) and what to check, in reading order.

1. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` (884): the menu rows and their values, each second level, the footer's 保存 / 恢复默认, and `FieldsPage` handing the shared `FieldList` the grid's shown columns, the hidden ones and the addable ones.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx` (57): the `list` and `value` faces the Layout level and its row use; the toolbar's `auto` face is unchanged.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewSwitcherMenu.tsx` (328, new): the dropdown body, with search, 我的视图 / shared grouping, type icons, wrapping names, and the 添加视图 foot.
4. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/CreateViewDialog.tsx` (562): `CreateViewCard`, with the name, type, the one field a type needs (defaulting to a shown field), 包含当前的筛选和排序, and the personal / shared switch only for a reader who may share. `uniqueViewKey` generates the machine key from the name, never shown.
5. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewViewCrud.tsx` (83): `useCreateViewInPlace`, the personal vs shared door. Personal saves one of the reader's own views and opens it; shared hands the body to the existing add-view door (draft, then publish), unchanged, under the generated key.
6. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/personalViews.ts` (62): `buildInPlaceViewConfig`, the one body both scopes store. It starts from the open view, is retyped with the type's picks, and lays the list on screen over it only when 包含当前的筛选和排序 is kept.
7. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (59): three new host props (`onRenameView`, `onSaveView`, `onResetView`) and the Options mount (the name row, the field order from the grid's column state, each field's type, 保存 / 恢复默认, the gallery's Row height by name), plus the two dead defaults-table rows.
8. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx` (24): forwards `listViewActions` and nothing else.
9. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` (87): the three cleared edits and the `listViewActions` gating.
10. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx` (340, mostly removed): mounts the new dropdown body; the save-as name-dialog mode is gone and the rename mode stays.
11. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (306 across eleven packs): the new `list.optionsMenu.*` and create-card words in every pack, `fieldsShown` as a count family, four dead keys dropped, and zh-Hant regenerated.
12. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` (34) and the changeset (16): the two items' revisions under Acceptance notes, and patch-level words.
13. Tests last. New: `inPlaceViewCreate-35553` (487), `optionsMenu-35551` (329) and `optionsHost-35551` (135). Migrated: 24 files (542), each a re-pointing to the menu's levels or the card. Retired: `layoutFold` (220).

<details><summary>Local readings at daa098ff16</summary>

- Round 3 merged origin/main c0716ed4a6 once (clean), swapped in the shared `FieldList` (81d0d5d33c) and passed each field's type to it (daa098ff16).
- Wide run at 81d0d5d33c: `packages/plugin-list/`, `packages/i18n/`, the column-identity ratchet, 29 app-shell files naming the card, the dropdown, the dialog or Options, and `personalViews-29635`. 314 files, 4282 passed, 13 skipped.
- At daa098ff16:
  - `packages/plugin-list/` in full: 180 files, 1949 passed.
  - `column-identity.ratchet`, `optionsMenu-35551`, `optionsHost-35551`, `fieldListRead-11984`, `emptyColumnsNoProjection-10694`: 5 files, 81 passed.
  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 171 files passed, 2 skipped; 5092 tests passed.
- Type-check at daa098ff16: plugin-list `type-check` exit 0. After a plugin-list rebuild, app-shell `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 48 run, each exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 48 derived, 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- i18n gates (ui `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`; root `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`): each exit 0. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0.
- Ablation of the type pass-through (`return typeof type === 'string' ? type : undefined;` → `return void type;` in `ListView.tsx`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the new type case in `optionsHost-35551` went red (`expected 'text' to be 'number'`, 1 failed). The file was restored to HEAD blob `c55f1729a2`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- `overlap-check` at daa098ff16: clean against origin/main e91d9671fa. The files shared with open PR #35643 (packs, checklist, `ListView.tsx` and some tests) merge cleanly.
- Round 2 readings at 1a2ba396a8 included app-shell `src/views/` in full (1559 files, 14795 passed, 1 skipped) and the card's shown-field default ablation (red, then restored).

</details>
